systems.system: Digital Value Chain Infrastructure for Boosting Employment (D-VIBE) project, also known as Project Bridge
systems.platform: 90,000 km of open-access fibre, taking the national backbone from about 30,000 km to about 120,000 km
systems.tiers: national; to connect all 774 local government areas, with no local government office said to be on it

note: A deal record of the African Development Bank's US$200m loan, approved in 2026, for a fibre backbone to reach all 774 local government areas; it names the areas, not their offices, so it is backbone and gives no fact.
